messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 5xx and token auth latency observed for hosted API + Dedicated pools in eu-west-1. Trigger: STS latency spike + CloudWatch ingest backpressure. Severity: P1. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aws-dep-outage

irina: seeing 500s from edge auth proxy -> STS timeouts. Graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/eu-west1-auth (latency spike at 17:04 UTC).

jamal: confirmed Dedicated p99 token latencies > 2s and host-side 502s. Failed request sample: `POST /v1/generate 502` auth_error=\"sts timeout\"

samantha: starting live mitigation plan: 1) enable regional fallback routing to eu-west-2 for Hosted API 2) scale Dedicated pools in eu-west-2 3) increase retries/backoff on auth client

alice: +1 on fallback. Routing change in progress, applying route override to edge-router: `edgectl routes set --region-fallback eu-west-2 --selector region=eu-west-1`

ben: bumped dedicated capacity by 2x in eu-west-2, provisioning GPUs now. ETA ~4m. Also toggled prefix-KV caching to reduce STS calls for warm sessions.

irina: added temporary retry policy in front of STS client: `retries=5, base=200ms, max=2s`. Monitoring error burst.

jamal: customer-impact check: Rate of 5xx increased for active sessions that target eu-west-1; estimated affected requests ~3.2% of platform traffic, majority short-lived degraded latency. Not seeing data plane data loss.

product-signal-bot: Alert: Spike in throttled gen requests from three paying customers (acct-987, acct-431, acct-220). SLO exposure flagged.

alice: dm'ing acct owners + CSMs. Preparing status update: short note + ETA for failover.

aws-support-bot: AWS has acknowledged elevated STS latencies in eu-west-1 (internal ticket #12345). Root cause being investigated. They recommend regional reroute and queueing.

jamal: rolling canary of fallback traffic to eu-west-2 now (5% -> 20%). Observing drop in 5xx for canary.

irina: can we reduce log volume to CloudWatch from runtime to ease ingest pressure? I'll flip debug off across fleet: `deploy toggle-logs --level=error --region=eu-west-1`

ben: done. Reduced metrics cardinality for runtime metrics exporter. CloudWatch errors trending down slightly.

samantha: notes for on-call handoff at 17:25 UTC: irina to continue mitigation, jamal to monitor customer impact and routing, ben to keep capacity scaling until stable. If 5xx < 0.5% for 15m, start rollback plan for fallback routes.

irina: copy. tagging postmortem owners: @jamal (lead), @samantha (comms), @ben (infra).

alice: publishing customer status page update: \"Service degraded in eu-west-1 affecting some hosted and dedicated requests. We have rerouted traffic and are working with AWS. Next update in 30 minutes.\"

jamal: logging timeline in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1748809123-eu-west1-sts-backpressure. Leaving this thread open for live updates.

incident-bot: Incident P1 recorded. Runbook step advanced: mitigation-in-progress -> monitoring-stable.\"
